Does each image belong in its frame?

Portrait illustrations fill their frames. Transparent emblems fit inside them. The choice belongs to the image’s purpose, rather than its position in a row.

The source checks fitting rules and refuses positional overrides. The admitted browser programme measures loading, natural dimensions, card bounds and consistent frame sizes at four declared widths. Deliberately broken images and a wrong-size card must fail their checks.

These diagnostic copies use eager image loading. They do not establish scrolling-triggered lazy loading, arbitrary computed CSS, or artistic crop quality.
